description: Ministry for the Environment Data Service (data.mfe.govt.nz), New Zealand is an open data portal listed in Ministry for the Environment Data Service (data.mfe.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministry for the Environment, New Zealand (MfE Data Service). Ministry for the Environment Data Service (data.mfe.govt.nz), New Zealand. This harvest searched it with infrastructure and hazard phrases in English and English and read 54 datasets; the ones whose titles name a transport, energy, water, digital or facility element or a hazard are catalogued as records of their own, and the rest (statistics, laws, contracts ... Coverage: New Zealand. 54 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 29 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-mfe-portal.
